announcements.headline: AGM Results & Investor Q&A Session
announcements.insight: The AGM results follow the September capital raise and October meeting notice. Shareholders should monitor the November director purchase for sentiment signals.

announcements.headline: TR-1: Standard Form for Notification of Major Holdings
Director Purchase of shares
announcements.insight: Director purchase follows the oversubscribed private placement. This signals internal confidence in the El Cedro discovery and recent capital raise.

announcements.headline: Notice of Annual and Special Meeting
announcements.insight: The meeting follows the September private placement. Shareholders will vote on matters related to the oversubscribed capital raise.

announcements.headline: Brokered LIFE Private Placement is Oversubscribed
announcements.insight: The oversubscribed private placement follows the September offer for up to C$14m. This confirms strong investor demand for the company's capital raise.

announcements.headline: Private Placement for Gross Proceeds up to C$14m
announcements.insight: Following recent discoveries at El Cedro and accelerating activity at Anzá, this capital raise supports ongoing project development.

announcements.headline: Orosur Mining Announces Discovery at El Cedro
announcements.insight: Orosur Mining Inc reports a discovery at El Cedro. This follows earlier updates on the Anzá and El Pantano projects, indicating continued exploration activity across its Colombian portfolio.

announcements.headline: Anzá Activity Accelerating
announcements.insight: Orosur Mining Inc reports accelerating activity at its El Pantano Project. This follows earlier updates on project development and a Colombian earthquake event.

announcements.headline: COLOMBIAN EARTHQUAKE
announcements.insight: The Colombian earthquake may impact the El Pantano Project. Shareholders should monitor for updates on operational status.

announcements.headline: El Pantano Project Developing
announcements.insight: El Pantano Project Developing indicates progress in Orosur Mining Inc's exploration activities. Shareholders should monitor subsequent announcements for updates on resource definition or funding.
